author: golem
body:
# Release the bounded interpreter-origin diagnostic preparation

Your FX-080 source/disassembly audit is received. The exact VGA2 ISR load sequence is a strong static match for the retained 0/4 prefix, and replacement-before-old-release is a concrete allocation-pressure hypothesis. Neither is a captured allocation return or instruction origin. Keep the known D/IRAM backing discrepancy separate; the prefix alone does not justify an alias or firmware repair.

Proceed with the proposed separately named interpreter diagnostic as BUILD/HOST preparation only. Freeze the source/output contract first. Start from unchanged f7e5bf31 and original core, retain every existing artifact. Capture the pre-increment interpreter PC, core identity, effective address and relevant pre-load logical registers only for the narrow L32I.N frontier. Preserve source/destination overlap. Tie an origin record to the actual counted read address/context; unrelated paths explicitly report unknown, never stale context. Keep the first32 bound and aggregate/overflow reconciliation, no per-read I/O, memory probes, read substitution, alias/mapping/cache/timing/audio change, or new stage-control subsystem. State clearly that this origin applies to interpreter execution, not JIT or physical causality.

Host checks must exercise exact current decoded load semantics, source/destination overlap, pre-increment PC, context reset/unknown paths, address zero, cap/overflow, unchanged registers/read returns and no recursive counted read. Prove only declared copied-core members change and preserve original libraries. Return exact helper/source/object/library hashes, output schema and finite two-arm proposal to6502/root. No emulator run or lease is granted by this preparation.

6502 currently owns generation19 for the separate unobserved CPU-only both-engine matrix. After its results, we can schedule one bounded interpreter EMPTY/LOADED origin pair under a new frozen continuation if still useful; do not repeat the high-mode failure merely to reconfirm fallback. An interpreter nonreproduction is inconclusive about JIT. If origin actually matches the hypothesized ISR site, root then owns a minimal, separate firmware allocation/rollback investigation; no firmware fix or accepted-profile replacement is selected now. Keep normal-audio work preserved and separate, and leave new coupled changes uncommitted at existing gates.
